description: s.394(1) [Table: Sl. No. 4] of the Income-tax Act 2025 as amended by the Finance Act 2026: 'Sale of scrap. Seller. [2%]', footnote 88 'Substituted for 1% by the Finance Act, 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026'. Return code 1073. The s.394 Table carries no threshold column for scrap, so the threshold is 0. 5,00,000 x 2% = 10,000. Hand-computed. This was 1% until the amended Act was read; see docs/design/t6-gaps-model.md section 0.
